Headline: Retraction: Harrowgate throughput report
Publisher: Northern Business Daily
Date: 2025-03-11

Event_ID: EVT-A
Countries: Brenmark
Sectors: electronics; automotive
Reliability: 2

Retraction. Northern Business Daily retracts its report RM-DOC-0105 of 2025-03-06 on throughput at Harrowgate.

The 40 percent figure was taken from an unverified spreadsheet and is not supported by port records. We regret the error.
